data.name: HexAim
data.detailed_description:
HEXAIM is a single-player 3D aim trainer that loads your brain while you shoot. Fly down a neon hex tunnel, dodge incoming wall patterns, and hit targets while the game stacks cognitive challenges on top of your crosshair: Stroop colour tests, sequence recall, mental math, category picks and memory runs. Pure flicking is not enough here; you have to read, think and still land the shot.

Most trainers isolate your mouse hand. HEXAIM trains the thing that actually breaks in a real match: aiming while your attention is somewhere else.

WHAT YOU GET

  • MARATHON, a 26-level escalating campaign with checkpoints, lives and clutch saves
  • 40+ standalone training scenarios, each with its own leaderboard
  • Layered cognitive challenges: Stroop, sequence, memory, mental math and category picks
  • Online leaderboards with weekly periods and pinned all-time bests
  • Full run history and lifetime stats

MARATHON

  • A 26-level difficulty curve that escalates speed, hazards and cognitive load
  • Checkpoints, lives and clutch saves. Survive a killing blow with a last-second precision shot
  • Bouncing threat targets, moving wall gates and hazard patterns that force constant repositioning

COGNITIVE CHALLENGES

  • Stroop tests. Read the word, ignore the ink colour, shoot the matching ball
  • Sequence, numeric and sort challenges. Shoot the right balls in the right order under time pressure
  • Memory runs. Words are planted mid-play; recall and shoot them in order later
  • Mental math and category picks. Solve it fast, then put the shot where the answer is

40+ TRAINING SCENARIOS

  • Focused drills for flicking, tracking, switching, micro-adjustment and reaction speed
  • Room-based precision scenarios and tunnel gauntlets, each with its own leaderboard
  • Play a two-minute warmup before you queue, or grind a single weakness for an hour

COMPETE

  • Online leaderboards with weekly periods and pinned all-time bests
  • Full run history and lifetime stats, cloud-saved to your free HexAim account

BUILT FOR TRAINING

  • Raw mouse input, no smoothing and no OS acceleration
  • 360-degree free look, unrestricted yaw
  • Readable neon visuals tuned for target contrast

NOTE

HEXAIM uses a free HexAim account to sync your stats, run history and leaderboard placements across sessions.

data.short_description: A cognitive aim trainer built to actually make you better at any FPS. Instead of static rooms, it overwhelms you with cognitive challenges, dodging, multi-tasking and much more, all while you practice your aim, so when you jump back into your main shooter, it feels 10x easier.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with WebGL2 / DirectX 11 support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
